description: This file defines the UPSShippingQuote class, implementing shipping quote integration via UPS's online API. It handles configuration validation, constructs and sends XML-based requests to UPS, parses responses, and provides shipping options. Contains usage of external HTTP, XML parsing, and UPS-specific service logic.

classes.name: UPSShippingQuote
classes.description: Main class implementing shipping quote retrieval via UPS API, including validation, request construction, response parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: UPSParsedElements
classes.description: Helper class for parsing and holding UPS API response elements such as status, error messages, and shipping options.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the UPS module configuration, ensuring required keys and options are provided.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Constructs UPS rate request XML, sends it via HTTP, parses the response, and returns list of shipping options.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Returns null, as no custom configuration is implemented for UPS shipping module.
